evals.prompt: Спроектируй production-интеграцию создания платежа, но ничего у провайдера не вызывай. Контракт провайдера говорит: POST /payments принимает Idempotency-Key, ключ scoped к merchant и хранится 24 часа, повтор допустим только с тем же payload; статус можно найти по merchant_reference. После отправки JSON соединение оборвалось до чтения ответа. Позже provider присылает подписанный webhook с event_id и payment_id, доставки могут дублироваться и приходить не по порядку. Наш HTTP request должен завершиться за 2 секунды. Опиши реализацию, восстановление и доказательство, не проектируя ledger semantics.
evals.expected_output: A boundary-complete payment integration design that preserves one operation identity through an after-send ambiguous outcome, safely correlates webhook or lookup evidence, reconciles missing delivery, and defines authority, security, observability, rollout, and executable failure proof without making a provider call or inventing payment guarantees.
expectations: Creates a durable local operation before the first send, binds one provider idempotency key and immutable payload/merchant scope to it, and does not create a new identity merely because the response was lost.
Classifies the after-send disconnect as ambiguous rather than failed or successful, and resolves it through the documented merchant_reference lookup and authenticated webhook before any new write.

Fits authentication, send, any eligible retry, and response handling inside the two-second end-to-end deadline while allowing separately owned reconciliation to continue later; it does not assume that every POST or 5xx is retryable.

Defines raw-payload signature verification, replay/deduplication by documented event identity, durable fast acceptance, asynchronous processing, and out-of-order handling without taking ownership of ledger transitions.
Defines observable ambiguity age, attempts, provider request/payment correlation, webhook verification/duplicates/lag, and reconciliation drift with an executable connection-loss-after-send test.
Keeps provider calls and webhook registration outside the read-only authority and labels documented provider facts separately from inferred behavior, including the 24-hour idempotency limit.

evals.prompt: Нужно спроектировать возобновляемую синхронизацию CRM contacts. API отдаёт opaque next_cursor, позволяет 4 concurrent requests на tenant и иногда отвечает 429 с Retry-After. Процесс падает после записи части страницы. Один contact стабильно возвращает documented validation error, остальные валидны. Изменения и удаления в CRM продолжаются во время sync. Нужны restart/checkpoint, error policy, reconciliation, метрики и тесты; реальные данные не трогай.
evals.expected_output: A resumable, quota-aware synchronization boundary that does not skip or duplicate durable effects across crashes, does not retry a permanent validation error forever, and explicitly handles mutable pagination, deletion/drift recovery, authority, and executable failure tests without inventing cursor guarantees.
expectations: Treats the cursor as opaque, pins tenant/filter/sort/version inputs, and advances a durable checkpoint only after all accepted page effects and permanent-failure records are durable and idempotent.
Explains both crash sides of checkpoint advancement and provides a safe replay/deduplication result instead of claiming exactly-once delivery from pagination.

Honors Retry-After no earlier than the provider signal, bounds elapsed retries and concurrency at four per tenant, shares quota pressure, and stops or reschedules when delay exceeds the synchronization deadline.

Classifies the documented validation error as permanent, records/quarantines it with an explicit partial-progress handoff, and allows unrelated contacts to progress only if the business contract permits it.

Names the lack of a stated snapshot/deletion guarantee, proposes provider-supported watermark/overlap or bounded full reconciliation rather than parsing or guessing the cursor, and measures checkpoint age, throttle delay, permanent failures, and drift.
Remains read-only against CRM data and defines fault tests for partial-page crash, expired/replayed cursor, 429 variants, duplicate contact, concurrent limiter use, mutation, and deletion.

evals.prompt: Исправь дизайн OAuth client для внешнего API. Access token живёт 10 минут, refresh token rotates on every refresh, 20 workers одновременно видят expiry, а API иногда возвращает 401. Сейчас каждый worker refresh-ит сам и безусловно повторяет исходный POST. Нужны least-privilege scopes, безопасная ротация client credential без простоя и production-ready tests. Можно менять только локальный код и тесты; менять credentials у провайдера нельзя.
evals.expected_output: A locally implementable OAuth lifecycle fix with correctly bound token caching, single-flight refresh, atomic rotating-refresh-token publication, bounded 401 handling tied to request replay safety, scoped credentials, observable failures, and a separately authorized provider-rotation procedure.
expectations: Keys the token cache by provider/environment/tenant or subject/audience/scopes/client identity and prevents credentials or tokens from crossing those boundaries.

Coordinates the 20 workers so one refresh occurs per security binding and stores the new refresh-token generation atomically before publishing the access token; a stale refresher cannot overwrite a newer generation.

Refreshes on 401 only when the provider authentication contract identifies an expired/invalid token, then replays at most once and only when the original operation identity makes the POST safe; revoked scope, repeated 401, and invalid_grant are terminal owned states.

Defines minimum scopes/audience, secret redaction/storage, cancellation and end-to-end deadline propagation through refresh waiting, and metrics for token age, refresh result/latency, waiters, repeated 401, and credential generation without leaking secrets.

Separates local build authority from external credential creation/activation/revocation, and gives an overlap/readback/old-key revocation plan conditional on provider support without claiming rotation has happened.
Includes executable concurrent-expiry, refresh race, rotating-token crash, eligible and ineligible 401 replay, deadline/cancellation, secret-leak, and old/new credential tests.

evals.prompt: Спроектируй webhook receiver. Официальный контракт провайдера требует HMAC-SHA256 по timestamp + raw body, допускает 5 минут clock skew, даёт delivery_id, повторяет delivery до 48 часов, не гарантирует порядок и ждёт 2xx не дольше 3 секунд. Сейчас framework сначала парсит JSON, handler сразу обновляет состояние, а duplicate делает update повторно. Нужны security, replay protection, dedupe, ordering, async processing, recovery и rollout; webhook у провайдера не регистрируй и production events не replay-ь.
evals.expected_output: A secure webhook boundary that authenticates exact bytes and freshness before durable acceptance, acknowledges quickly after atomic deduplication, processes asynchronously without order assumptions, reconciles lost or incompatible events, and respects external-action authority.
expectations: Moves verification ahead of parsing and any effect, uses the exact raw body plus signed timestamp and the documented five-minute tolerance, constant-time HMAC comparison or official library, correct environment/key generation, TLS, and bounded body handling.

Atomically retains the authenticated delivery envelope and delivery_id before a sub-three-second 2xx; durable-store failure returns the provider-defined retry response and business work occurs asynchronously.

Makes concurrent duplicate delivery a no-op with the same safe acknowledgement, retains dedupe evidence for at least the documented 48-hour redelivery window, and does not confuse timestamp freshness with deduplication.

Assumes unordered delivery, prevents stale events from regressing state, and uses documented resource version/lookup plus reconciliation for gaps instead of sorting by local receipt time or inventing sequence guarantees.

Observes verification and replay rejection, duplicates, acknowledgement and processing lag, queue age, unknown schemas, and reconciliation drift; tests byte mutation, stale/future timestamp, wrong key, concurrent duplicate, reorder, durable-store failure, slow consumer, and dropped callback.
Treats webhook registration, signing-key change, and production replay as separately authorized actions with bounded rollout/rollback, and does not claim any was performed.

evals.prompt: Сделай только read-only review HTTP client. Он использует один global retry middleware: три раза повторяет любой 4xx/5xx и network error, включая POST; timeout не задан, context/cancellation не передаётся, 429 игнорирует Retry-After, 401 повторяется с тем же token. Provider docs и idempotency semantics в репозитории не зафиксированы. Найди production-риски, причину и предложи минимальный план исправления и проверки. Код не меняй и внешние запросы не делай.
evals.expected_output: A read-only root-cause review showing that policy-free global retries and unbounded I/O break the external boundary, with operation-specific remediation, explicit evidence gaps, recovery/observability/security requirements, and executable tests rather than code changes or fabricated provider guarantees.
expectations: Preserves read-only authority: inspects and reports without editing code, calling the provider, changing credentials, or claiming a fix was applied.

Identifies the shared global middleware as the root cause affecting all callers, traces or requests the caller/operation inventory, and distinguishes duplicate-side-effect, retry-storm, deadline leak, cancellation, quota, and stale-credential risks.

Does not replace the middleware with a universal status table; requires each operation's provider contract, identity/idempotency scope and retention, retry eligibility, deadline, outcome taxonomy, and ambiguity resolution before enabling retries.

Classifies after-possible-send network failures and side-effecting 5xx as potentially ambiguous, makes permanent failures consume zero retry budget, handles 429 provider delay within a deadline/quota budget, and allows at most one contract-backed token refresh/replay when the operation is safe.

Defines reconciliation for unresolved effects, scoped observability for latency/attempts/throttling/ambiguity/authentication/drift, and executable tests for unbounded I/O, cancellation, after-send loss, 429, permanent 4xx, repeated 401, and retry exhaustion.
Separates confirmed code facts from missing provider guarantees and leaves readiness not ready until contracts and behavioral failure tests exist; static validation is not presented as runtime proof.
Prioritizes the retry middleware and affected boundary stages; does not invent webhook, migration, database, or rollout sections that do not change the review verdict.

evals.prompt: Сделай узкий read-only review только GET /inventory/{sku}. Операция не имеет side effects. Общий deadline запроса — 800 мс, но текущий client на каждый attempt создаёт новый timeout 2 секунды и трижды повторяет 429, игнорируя Retry-After. Provider документирует Retry-After в секундах и quota per tenant. Дай только причину, минимальную безопасную policy и один executable test. Код не меняй, provider не вызывай; не проектируй OAuth, webhooks, reconciliation, database schema или rollout.
evals.expected_output: A compact read-only diagnosis of the unbounded per-attempt timeout and incorrect 429 policy for one side-effect-free GET, with one tenant-scoped bounded correction and exactly one executable test, without unrelated integration architecture.
expectations: Preserves read-only authority and does not claim code or provider changes.
Replaces per-attempt full timeouts with one 800 ms end-to-end monotonic deadline whose remaining budget covers attempts, waits, response reading, and cancellation.
Treats Retry-After as a no-earlier-than provider signal, makes no retry when the delay cannot fit the remaining budget, and bounds attempts and elapsed retry time.
Scopes quota/concurrency coordination to the documented tenant boundary rather than using unrelated global or per-request retry pressure.
Provides exactly one executable focused test that proves no sleep or attempt crosses the 800 ms deadline, including a Retry-After value beyond the remaining budget.
Does not add operation identity, ambiguous-side-effect recovery, OAuth, webhook, reconciliation, schema, migration, or rollout material that cannot change this GET-policy verdict.

evals.prompt: Сделай узкий read-only review только retry-policy для POST /shipping-labels. Провайдер документирует Idempotency-Key со scope account, retention 6 часов и повтор только с тем же payload; результат можно найти по client_reference. Сейчас после timeout код создаёт новый key и повторяет POST. Ответ дай ровно как: verdict, root cause, две минимальные code changes и один executable test. Код не меняй, provider не вызывай; не добавляй webhook, database, migration или rollout design.
evals.expected_output: A compact read-only review that treats the timed-out write as ambiguous, preserves one operation identity and provider key, resolves it through client_reference lookup, and fits exactly two minimal corrections plus one executable failure test without unrelated architecture.
expectations: Preserves read-only authority and does not claim code or provider changes.
Classifies a timeout after possible transmission as ambiguous and requires the documented client_reference lookup before another write.

Keeps one durable local operation identity, one account-scoped provider key, and the same canonical payload across attempts; it records the six-hour retention as a recovery limit rather than inventing indefinite safety.
Provides exactly two minimal code changes that repair the shared identity/retry path instead of expanding into a full integration redesign.
Provides exactly one executable test that loses the response after possible provider acceptance and proves lookup/retry cannot create a second label.
Keeps documented provider guarantees distinct from local implementation decisions and any remaining unknowns, without adding webhook, database, migration, or rollout sections.

evals.prompt: Спроектируй production migration shipping-интеграции с Provider A на Provider B без внешних вызовов. Есть два side effects: create label и cancel label. A документирует idempotency 24 часа per account, lookup по client_reference и duplicate/unordered webhooks. B документирует для create idempotency 7 дней per tenant с тем же payload и lookup по operation_reference; для cancel документация не говорит ни про idempotency, ни про lookup после timeout. Во время cutover остаются in-flight операции и callbacks A. Нужны boundary contract, routing ownership, ambiguous recovery, reconciliation, canary, rollback и proof; бизнес-смысл заказа и database schema оставь соседним владельцам.
evals.expected_output: A production migration design with an auditable per-effect boundary ledger, one writer and stable local identity across routing, provider-specific recovery for A and B create, an explicit readiness blocker for B cancel ambiguity, continued handling of A in-flight work, and executable cutover proof without claiming external actions occurred.
expectations: Creates separate ledger rows for A create, B create, B cancel, and the relevant callback or reconciliation paths, distinguishing documented provider evidence, local invariants, inferences or gaps, and authority.
Keeps one stable local operation identity across routing and assigns every operation to exactly one provider writer; retries never become a migration-driven dual write.

Uses A client_reference and B operation_reference plus their distinct key scopes and retention windows for provider-specific lookup and ambiguous recovery rather than normalizing them into one invented guarantee.
Marks B cancel not ready for automatic after-send retry because idempotency and lookup are undocumented, and names the provider evidence or compensating path required to unblock it.
Continues A callback handling and reconciliation until in-flight and ambiguous A work is drained; rollback stops new B routing without erasing B effects or abandoning A callbacks.

Defines a bounded canary, quota and stop signals, fault tests for loss around both providers and cutover ownership, and separately authorized external activation while leaving business and database internals to their owners.

evals.prompt: Сделай read-only design review Go-клиента POST /hotel-holds. Контракт caller менять нельзя: authentication, send, любой допустимый retry и чтение/парсинг ответа должны завершиться внутри одного monotonic deadline 900 мс. Provider документирует Idempotency-Key на 30 минут per hotel для того же body и lookup по reservation_ref; потеря ответа после send неоднозначна. Reconciliation может продолжиться после 900 мс. Ответ: verdict, точный budget, recovery и одна runnable Go test function. Не предлагай 202/pending, код не меняй, provider не вызывай.
evals.expected_output: A compact synchronous-boundary review that preserves the fixed 900 ms caller promise, uses one durable operation identity and provider key, hands only unresolved post-deadline ambiguity to reconciliation, and includes runnable commit-then-response-loss proof.
expectations: Preserves read-only authority and the fixed synchronous completion contract; it does not evade the 900 ms deadline with 202, pending, or a background send.
Budgets authentication, send, any eligible same-operation retry, response reading, parsing, and cancellation inside one monotonic 900 ms deadline using remaining time before each blocking stage.
Creates one durable local hold-operation identity before I/O and binds one hotel-scoped key, reservation_ref, and canonical body to it for at most the documented 30-minute provider window.

Treats after-send response loss as ambiguous, performs reservation_ref lookup before another write, and hands unresolved work after the synchronous deadline to separately owned reconciliation without claiming synchronous success.
Provides one runnable Go test function whose fake provider commits the first hold before losing the response and proves lookup or a same-key retry cannot create a second hold.
Keeps provider guarantees, local policy, remaining lookup-visibility gaps, and external authority distinct without widening into webhook, schema, or migration design.

evals.prompt: Сделай узкий read-only review resumable ERP sync. Страница содержит 100 invoices и cursor next_42. Один invoice получает документированный permanent validation error. Текущий worker quarantines его, применяет остальные 99 и сохраняет next_42. Но контракт владельца billing — page-atomic: checkpoint нельзя продвигать, пока вся страница не принята или владелец явно не изменил правило. Дай verdict, root cause, ровно две corrections и один executable crash/restart test. Код не меняй; не проектируй OAuth, webhooks, migration или database schema.
evals.expected_output: A narrow review that respects the page-atomic owner contract, prevents checkpoint advancement and partial visibility after a permanent item failure, names the only authority that may allow partial progress, and proves replay safety across a crash.
expectations: Preserves read-only authority and classifies the documented validation failure as permanent without retrying it as transport noise.
Treats unconditional quarantine-plus-next_42 advancement as the root cause because it violates the explicit page-atomic billing contract.
Keeps the page outcome and checkpoint unchanged until all 100 items are durably accepted; partial progress becomes legal only through an explicit billing-owner contract change and handoff.
Provides exactly two corrections covering durable page state and atomic effect/checkpoint publication without inventing database schema internals.
Provides exactly one runnable crash/restart test that fails after item processing but before checkpoint publication and proves replay cannot expose 99 partial items or skip the failed page.
Keeps the response scoped to sync semantics, ownership, checkpoint, and proof without unrelated authentication, webhook, migration, or rollout material.

evals.prompt: Сделай read-only review общего Rust retry Layer, который используют GET catalog, POST invoice, DELETE access-token и OAuth refresh. Сейчас он повторяет любой network error и 4xx/5xx три раза, не передаёт cancellation, ставит новый 2s timeout на attempt и имеет один global semaphore. У callers разные deadlines и provider quota scopes; idempotency для POST/DELETE не зафиксирована. Ответ должен содержать affected-caller matrix, минимальный replacement policy interface, scoped observability и ровно три executable tests. Код и provider state не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A caller-inventory-first review that replaces the global method-agnostic retry behavior with operation contracts, bounded deadlines, identity-aware ambiguity handling, scoped quota/auth policy, observable recovery, and three focused runnable tests.
expectations: Preserves read-only authority and inventories all four caller/operation classes rather than treating the shared Layer as one uniform HTTP policy.

The caller matrix distinguishes side effects, known or missing idempotency, caller deadline/cancellation, authentication role, quota scope, ambiguous-outcome observation, and current readiness for GET, POST, DELETE, and refresh.

Defines a minimal per-operation policy interface instead of another universal status or method table; policy carries exact deadline, retry eligibility, stable identity, quota scope, and ambiguity resolver where relevant.

Uses one end-to-end remaining budget, propagates cancellation, refuses after-possible-send automatic retries without evidence, and avoids retrying permanent 4xx or repeatedly refreshing the same credential.
Defines scoped signals for latency/budget, attempts, throttling, ambiguity age, authentication refresh, and reconciliation drift with bounded-cardinality correlation.

Provides exactly three runnable tests covering deadline/cancellation, commit-then-loss duplicate prevention for a side effect, and combined 429 or repeated-401 exhaustion without widening into webhook, schema, or migration work.

evals.prompt: Спроектируй read-only production migration transactional-email integration с Provider A на Provider B, максимум 900 слов. Side effects: send message и add suppression. A документирует idempotency 24 часа per account, lookup по message_ref и duplicate/unordered callbacks. B для send документирует idempotency 7 дней per tenant с тем же payload и lookup по operation_ref; для add suppression у B не документированы idempotency и lookup после timeout. Во время cutover остаются in-flight sends и callbacks A. Нужны readiness, compact decision ledger, one-writer routing, ambiguous recovery, reconciliation, canary, rollback и proof. Внешних вызовов не делай; production activation отдельно не авторизована.
evals.expected_output: A concise multi-effect migration design with a complete auditable ledger, provider-specific recovery, a hard blocker for ambiguous B suppression writes, continued A drainage, one-writer rollback, executable proof, and explicit activation authority within 900 words.
expectations: Stays within 900 words and leads with a read-only not-ready verdict that separates design from unauthorized sandbox or production activation.

Renders compact separate ledger rows for A send, B send, B suppression, and callback or reconciliation paths with provider evidence/gaps, local invariant/owner, identity, deadline, recovery/proof, and authority.
Pins one durable local operation identity and exactly one provider writer across routing; retries, rollback, and callbacks never create migration-driven dual writes.

Uses A message_ref and B operation_ref with their distinct scopes/windows, while marking B suppression after-send ambiguity unresolved and not automatically retryable until provider evidence or an authorized compensation path exists.
Keeps A callbacks and reconciliation alive until A in-flight and ambiguous work drains; rollback stops only new B routing and continues observing effects already sent to both providers.

Defines a bounded canary, quota and duplicate/ambiguity/auth/drift stop signals, runnable fault tests around provider acceptance and cutover ownership, and a separate authorization gate for external activation.
